reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cream: Retinal Liposome 1%+Fermented Rice 50ml
reviews.text: This cream feels nourishing while helping smooth texture, but I did not find it as effective as my other retinal cream.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜感覺有滋養，同時幫助平滑膚質，但我覺得佢無我另一款 retinal 面霜咁有效。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cream: Retinal Liposome 1%+Fermented Rice 50ml
reviews.text: So far so good, been using this product for 2 months now and feel like I've seen some minor changes to my skin, looks more hydrated and pore appearing less clogged. Not had much irritation other than very minor skin peeling at first. Retinol takes 6 months for full effects to be seen so will continue to use and see how things change.
reviews.zh: 到目前為止都幾好，用咗呢個產品 2 個月，覺得皮膚有少少變化，望落更保濕，毛孔冇咁塞。除咗初期有少少甩皮之外，冇乜刺激。視黃醇要 6 個月先見到完整效果，所以會繼續用，睇下之後點變。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cream: Retinal Liposome 1%+Fermented Rice 50ml
reviews.text: Good eye cream, It's hydrating, I use it at night. It abscobs quixkly
reviews.zh: 唔錯嘅眼霜，夠保濕，我夜晚用，吸收得好快。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cream: Retinal Liposome 1%+Fermented Rice 50ml
reviews.text: I'm new to the whole world of retinol and I have to say that this product is really good. It doesn't have a lot of retinol in it, but for someone who's new to it, it's really good. You see results gradually and there's a change in your face.
reviews.zh: 我係視黃醇嘅新手，不得不講呢個產品真係幾好。成分入面視黃醇唔算好多，但對新手嚟講真係幾好。效果係逐步見到，塊面會有變化。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cream: Retinal Liposome 1%+Fermented Rice 50ml
reviews.text:
“This cream is unreal. The texture melts into the skin like a warm whisper, leaving that soft Korean glow that looks naturally seductive, not forced.
The retinal is strong but gentle — no irritation, just smooth, glassy skin that looks tighter and more defined every morning.
It gives me that clean, sexy, ‘K-drama close-up’ vibe. Instant favorite.”
reviews.zh:
「呢款面霜真係超正。質地溶入皮膚，好似溫柔嘅低語，留低柔和嘅韓系光澤，望落自然又誘人，唔係裝出嚟。
Retinal 夠強但溫和——冇刺激，只有光滑似玻璃嘅皮膚，朝早望落更緊緻更有輪廓。
俾到我一種乾淨、性感嘅『韓劇大特寫』感覺。即刻成為最愛。」

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cream: Retinal Liposome 1%+Fermented Rice 50ml
reviews.text: A very gentle retinal. It's easy to use and perfect for those who haven't had any experience with retinols before.
reviews.zh: 好溫和嘅 retinal，易用，對從未用過視黃醇嘅人嚟講係完美選擇。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cream: Retinal Liposome 1%+Fermented Rice 50ml
reviews.text: This is the second time I've ordered this series, including the eye cream. In my opinion, these are the best retinol products I've tried. I use it every night. I have no irritation or redness on my skin and the feeling is excellent. In my opinion, it made a huge difference in my facial skin.
reviews.zh: 呢個系列係我第二次回購，包括眼霜。我覺得呢啲係我用過最好嘅視黃醇產品。我每晚用，皮膚冇刺激感或泛紅，感覺極佳。我覺得佢對我面部皮膚有明顯改善。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cream: Retinal Liposome 1%+Fermented Rice 50ml
reviews.text: I bought this cream and have used it once — I liked it. I’ll continue using it and write a full review later.
reviews.zh: 我買咗呢款面霜，已經用咗一次，鍾意。會繼續用，之後再寫完整評價。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
